Eastern Times 8- 28.4.37
CHUNGKING GOVERNMENT OFFICIAL MISSING
IN SHANGHAI
According to information from quarters
concerned, a man named Jang (張), who is an important
official of the Chungking Government responsible for
certain activities in Shanghai, has been missing since
June 19 when he went out to keep an appointment with a
friend. His relatives and friends are anxious to know
his whereabouts.
（印：SHANGHAI 26 JUNE 1937 CONSULAR OFFICE）
pages.zh:
《申报》 1937年4月28日
重庆政府官员在上海失踪

据有关方面消息，一名名为张（張）的男子，系负责上海某些活动的重庆政府重要官员，自6月19日外出赴友人之约后一直下落不明。其亲友急切希望得知其行踪。
（印：上海 1937年6月26日 领事馆办公室）

pages.en:
G. SCM-2-4
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
S.B. Special Branch Station,
REPORT
Date: July 4. 1939.
Subject. Objectionable article published in the "Eastern Times" on June
28, 1939.
Made by....................and........................Forwarded by.........J. S. Lockwood.

With reference to the article entitled
"Chungking Government Official Missing in Shanghai"
published in the "Eastern Times" on June 28, 1939, Mr
Chen Ta-van (陈达文), Assistant Editor of the paper,
was interviewed at Police Headquarters on July 3, 1939
when he was asked the source of this information.
Mr. Chen stated that the article was contributed by
an unknown person and to substantiate his statement, he
produced the attached draft. Mr. Chen was warned that
articles of this type are undesirable and objectionable
from a Police viewpoint.
It was suggested to Mr. Chen that it would be
in his interest to refer any articles on a doubtful or
objectionable subject to the police for an opinion
before he published it.

J. S. Lockwood.
D. S.

D. C. (Special Branch).

（批：+13）
（批：FILE / D.R. / -7）

报告
日期：1939年7月4日
事由：1939年6月28日《申报》刊登的不当文章。
制作人....................及........................转呈人.........J. S. Lockwood。

关于1939年6月28日《申报》刊登的题为“重庆政府官员在上海失踪”的文章，该报副主编陈达文（陈达文）于1939年7月3日在警察总局接受问询，被问及该消息来源。陈先生称该文章由一名身份不明的人士投稿，并为证实其说法，他出示了附上的草稿。警方警告陈先生，从警务角度来看，此类文章是不受欢迎且不当的。
警方建议陈先生，为了其自身利益，在刊登任何主题可疑或不当的文章之前，应先征求警方意见。

J. S. Lockwood
副警司

特别处助理总监

June 28, 1939.
Morning Translation

Eastern Times :-

CHUNGKING GOVERNMENT OFFICIAL MISSING
IN SHANGHAI

According to information from quarters
concerned, a man named Jang (張), who is an important
official of the Chungking Government responsible for
certain activities in Shanghai, has been missing since
June 19 when he went out to keep an appointment with a
friend. His relatives and friends are anxious to know
his whereabouts.
